title: BridgeFsck
description: Offline bridge audit emitted by `rebar bridge fsck --output json`. `unknown_event_types` scans top-level events on the committed tickets ref, `binding_drift` preserves the classifier's offline report, and `store_integrity` validates the forward/reverse binding indexes.

unknown_event_types.description: Sorted unknown top-level event types found on refs/heads/tickets. Informational; does not change the exit status.

binding_drift.description: Binding-level drift from the classifier's offline-decidable cells. Informational cells remain non-gating.

local_gone.description: Bound but the local ticket is absent from the store (ALERT).

retired_overlap.description: A jira_key present in BOTH the live and retired binding stores.

dangling.description: Confirmed binding whose Jira issue is gone (informational).

orphaned_bindings.description: Bridge orphaned bindings, annotated with a reason such as local_gone or confirmed_404 (informational).

orphaned_jira.description: Jira issues that still carry a rebar-id label but have no live binding (informational).

unbound_local.description: Local tickets with no confirmed Jira binding, surfaced for bridge migration parity (informational).

absent_in_window_unprobed.description: Binding absent from a windowed snapshot without a confirming probe (informational).

indeterminate.description: Terminal-local binding whose Jira issue is present but whose key-set snapshot lacks the status needed to decide a terminal transition (informational; never alerts).

store_integrity.description: Forward/reverse bindings.json inconsistencies. Any finding makes fsck exit 1.
